storyChapters.title: A mark that belongs to them.
storyChapters.description: The AC monogram gives Ananya and Chirag’s celebration its own signature. Personal, recognisable, and at the centre of the design.

storyChapters.title: A little sense of place.
storyChapters.description: Palms, seashells, and coastal colours carry the feeling of the shore into the artwork. The setting becomes part of the story.

storyChapters.title: One story, in every detail.
storyChapters.description: The complete composition brings the monogram, illustration, and names together into a visual identity for the couple’s celebration.
